root_problem: Qwen через qwen-local теряет контекст, потому что Hermes не привязывает стабильную Hermes session к Qwen chatId/parentId.

quality_gates.deepseek_search: Read-only DeepSeek/ds_scout search for relevant provider/session code paths before implementation.
quality_gates.targeted_tests: Pytest coverage for Qwen session state and non-Qwen regression.
quality_gates.live_smoke: qwen-local live smoke for context preservation and tool_calls.
quality_gates.independent_review: delegate_task reviewer returns APPROVE or non-blocking warnings only.

goals.title: Map Hermes provider/session code paths
goals.problem_solved: Находит точные места, куда добавить Qwen state, не раздувая контекст главного агента.
goals.acceptance: DeepSeek/ds_scout or equivalent read-only subagent returns file:line evidence for provider setup, request creation, session id availability, and tests to extend.
goals.evidence: DeepSeek/ds_scout returned file:line evidence for provider resolution, chat kwargs, AIAgent session fields, request overrides, tests, and profile-safe storage candidates.

goals.title: Implement Qwen session persistence
goals.problem_solved: Привязывает одну Hermes session к одному Qwen chatId/parentId so Qwen не забывает чат между сообщениями.
goals.acceptance: Code stores/restores Qwen chatId/parentId profile-safely for Qwen provider only; existing providers keep current request shape.
goals.evidence: Implemented agent/qwen_session_state.py, wired qwen-local metadata into build_api_kwargs, legacy transport top-level metadata, and response chatId/parentId persistence hook.

goals.title: Add targeted tests
goals.problem_solved: Защищает новый Qwen mapping от регрессии и доказывает, что обычные custom providers не затронуты.
goals.acceptance: Relevant pytest tests pass and include Qwen state save/restore plus non-Qwen regression.

goals.title: Run live qwen-local smoke
goals.problem_solved: Проверяет реальное поведение на поднятом Qwen proxy, а не только unit tests.
goals.acceptance: Live smoke shows same-session context preservation and OpenAI-compatible tool_calls through qwen-local.
goals.evidence: Live qwen-local smoke through Hermes AIAgent: context_ok=true with persisted qwen_sessions chatId/parentId; terminal tool smoke produced one assistant tool_call and one tool message.

goals.title: Independent review and final gate
goals.problem_solved: Снижает риск архитектурного костыля, утечек секретов или поломки Hermes tool loop.
goals.acceptance: Independent subagent review returns APPROVE/APPROVE_WITH_WARNINGS with no blockers; final verification commands and git diff are recorded.
goals.evidence: Independent delegate_task review returned APPROVE_WITH_WARNINGS with no blockers; W2 portal-exclusion test gap fixed; targeted tests now 30 passed; git diff --check clean.

final_evidence: Tests: python -m pytest tests/providers/test_profile_wiring.py tests/agent/test_custom_provider_extra_body.py tests/agent/test_qwen_session_state.py -q -o addopts= -> 30 passed. Live smoke: context_ok=true, state_has_chat_parent=true, tool_messages=1, assistant_tool_call_messages=1. Review: APPROVE_WITH_WARNINGS no blockers. Remaining warnings are non-blocking: broad qwen-name detection, no eviction for qwen_sessions.json, no explicit chmod beyond mkstemp default.
